title: A card from Jimmy
description: A dialogue lesson on reported speech. Grandmother asks Penny to read Jimmy's card to her. Penny reads the card (direct speech) and then reports it in indirect speech ('He says he's just arrived in Scotland. He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel.'). Grandmother asks what else Jimmy says, and Penny reports that he'll write a letter soon and hopes they are all well. Grandmother, who can't hear very well, asks Penny to speak up. New vocabulary includes Scotland, card, youth, hostel, association, soon, and write. Workbook practice covers comprehension questions on the dialogue and choosing the best word to fill in the blanks. Grammar exercises practise making sentences according to the example (reported speech with 'that') and rewriting sentences using a noun clause according to the example.
answer_note: Lesson listening question (Does Grandmother seem pleased to get a card from Jimmy?) is a suggested model answer based on the dialogue. Practice A (comprehension) 10 questions are taken from the supplied Lesson 101 key (img/key-101-106.jpg). Practice B (vocabulary, choose the best word) 8 items are taken from the supplied Lesson 101 key (img/key-101-106.jpg). Grammar I (make sentences according to the example) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 101 grammar key (PDF 新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf, viewer p. 531-532). Grammar II (rewrite the sentences, using a noun clause) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 101 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 532).

characters.grandmother: An elderly woman who can't hear very well and asks Penny to read Jimmy's card.
characters.penny: A young woman who reads Jimmy's card to her grandmother.

lesson-101-scene-01.description: Grandmother and Penny sitting in an armchair, Penny reading Jimmy's card to Grandmother, Grandmother asking Penny to speak up.
lesson-101-scene-01.reason: Odd lesson: text first; illustration deferred.

lesson.text:
Listen then answer this question. Does Grandmother seem pleased to get a card from Jimmy? Why/Why not?
听录音，然后回答问题。收到吉米寄来的一张明信片，祖母是否显得高兴？为什么？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and answer: Does Grandmother seem pleased to get a card from Jimmy? Why/Why not?

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: Read Jimmy's card to me please, Penny.
lines.translation: 祖母：请把吉米的明信片念给我听听，彭妮。

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.text: 'I have just arrived in Scotland and I'm staying at a Youth Hostel.'
lines.translation: 彭妮："我刚到苏格兰，我现在住在一所青年招待所。"

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.text:
He says he's just arrived in Scotland.
He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel.
You know he's a member of the Y.H.A.
lines.translation: 彭妮：他说他刚到苏格兰。他说他现住在一所青年招待所。您知道，他是 Y.H.A. 的一个会员。

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.text:
The Y.H.A., Mum.
The Youth Hostels Association.
lines.translation: 彭妮：Y.H.A.，妈妈。青年招待所协会。

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.text:
'I'll write a letter soon.
I hope you are all well.'
lines.translation: 彭妮："我很快会写信的。祝你们大家身体都好。"

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text:
What?
Speak up, Penny.
I'm afraid I can't hear you.
lines.translation: 祖母：什么？彭妮，大声一点。我可听不见你念的。

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.text:
He says he'll write a letter soon.
He hopes we are all well.
'Love, Jimmy.'
lines.translation: 彭妮：他说他很快会写信的。他祝我们大家身体好。"爱你们的吉米。"

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text:
Is that all?
He doesn't say very much, does he?
lines.translation: 祖母：就这些吗？他没写多少，是吗？

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.text:
He can't write very much
on a card, Mum.
lines.translation: 彭妮：在明信片上他写不了很多，妈妈。

lesson.title: Listen then answer this question
lesson.instruction: Listen then answer this question. Does Grandmother seem pleased to get a card from Jimmy? Why/Why not? 听录音，然后回答问题。收到吉米寄来的一张明信片，祖母是否显得高兴？为什么？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and answer: Does Grandmother seem pleased to get a card from Jimmy? Why/Why not?

questions.prompt: Does Grandmother seem pleased to get a card from Jimmy? Why/Why not?
questions.answer: Yes, she seems pleased. She asks Penny to read the card to her and asks what else Jimmy says, showing she is interested in hearing from him.

items.title: 'I have just arrived in Scotland ... a Youth Hostel.'
items.text: 这是一个直接引语的例子。直接引语是英文中用书面语的形式来表示口语的方式，实际讲的话要放在引号之间，句尾的标点符号也要放在引号之内。

items.title: the Y.H.A. = the Youth Hostels Association
items.text: 青年招待所协会，简称 Y.H.A.。Youth Hostel 是一种为参加野外探险度假活动的青年人提供廉价住宿的招待所。这种青年招待所实行会员制，首先要加入 Y.H.A. 才有资格享受这种待遇。

items.title: Love, Jimmy.
items.text: Love, Jimmy. 爱你们的吉米。Yours, Jimmy（你的，吉米）。这是亲人朋友间通信时常用的结束语。

items.title: He doesn't say very much, does he?
items.text: 这是英文中的反意疑问句，它是由两部分组成的，前面是一个陈述句，逗号之后是一个简略问句。反意疑问句可以用来确认自己的判断，获取真实的信息，还可以用来表示惊讶、愤怒等感情。如果前一部分陈述句是肯定形式，简略问句就要用否定形式；如果前一部分是否定形式，后一部分则用肯定形式。

practice.title: A — Comprehension
practice.instruction: Look at the dialogue on Students' Book page 205 and answer these questions. 参见学生用书第 205 页上的对话，然后回答以下问题。
practice.translation: Read the dialogue on page 205 and answer the questions.
practice.context: 10 comprehension questions. All answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 101 key (img/key-101-106.jpg).

questions.prompt: What does Penny read for Grandmother?
questions.answer: She reads a card from Jimmy.

questions.prompt: Where has Jimmy just arrived?
questions.answer: (He has just arrived) in Scotland.

questions.prompt: Where is he staying?
questions.answer: (He is staying) at a Youth Hostel.

questions.prompt: What is the Y.H.A.?
questions.answer: It is the Youth Hostels Association.

questions.prompt: Is Jimmy a member of the Y.H.A.?
questions.answer: Yes, he is.

questions.prompt: What else does Jimmy say on his card?
questions.answer: 'I'll write a letter soon. I hope you are all well.'

questions.prompt: Can Grandmother hear very well?
questions.answer: No, she can't.

questions.prompt: So what must Penny do?
questions.answer: She must speak up.

questions.prompt: Jimmy doesn't say very much on his card, does he?
questions.answer: No, he doesn't.

questions.prompt: How much can he write on a card?
questions.answer: He can't write very much. / Not very much.

practice.title: B — Vocabulary: Choose the best word and write it in
practice.instruction: Choose the best word and write it in. 选词填空。
practice.translation: Choose the best word from the pair in parentheses and write it in the blank.
practice.context: 8 items. All answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 101 key (img/key-101-106.jpg).

questions.prompt: Dear Penny, I have just ______ in Beijing. (come / arrived)
questions.answer: arrived

questions.prompt: My friend is ______ in a small London hotel for a week. (staying / living)
questions.answer: staying

questions.prompt: The letters Y.H.A. stand for the '______ Hostels Association'. (Young / Youth)
questions.answer: Youth

questions.prompt: You can't write very ______ on a postcard. (much / many)
questions.answer: much

questions.prompt: 'Can you ______?' the man said. 'I can't hear very well.' (say to / speak up)
questions.answer: speak up

questions.prompt: 'Did you ______ to your friend in Australia last week? (read / write)
questions.answer: write

questions.prompt: ______ is in the north of the U.K. (England / Scotland)
questions.answer: Scotland

questions.prompt: Did you know? I'm a ______ of that new sports club. (person / member)
questions.answer: member

grammar.title: I. Make sentences according to the example. 仿照例句造句。
grammar.instruction:
Make sentences according to the example. 仿照例句造句。

Example (item 1):
he says/he feels hot
He says he feels hot.
grammar.translation: Make a sentence from each pair of clauses, following the printed example. Join them with 'that' (or omit 'that').
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf
grammar.context: 10 items. Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 101 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 531-532).

questions.prompt: he says/he feels hot
questions.answer: He says he feels hot.

questions.prompt: she says/she is staying in Rome
questions.answer: She says she's staying in Rome.

questions.prompt: I am sure/they enjoyed their holiday in Greece
questions.answer: I'm sure they enjoyed their holiday in Greece.

questions.prompt: I am afraid/it's going to be windy tomorrow
questions.answer: I'm afraid it's going to be windy tomorrow.

questions.prompt: the doctor says/you must stay at home for a week
questions.answer: The doctor says you must stay at home for a week.

questions.prompt: I am sorry/he hasn't got better
questions.answer: I'm sorry he hasn't got better.

questions.prompt: he believes/he can finish it in ten minutes
questions.answer: He believes he can finish it in ten minutes.

questions.prompt: she hopes/she will go to university next year
questions.answer: She hopes she'll go to university next year.

questions.prompt: he says/he usually goes to work by bus
questions.answer: He says he usually goes to work by bus.

questions.prompt: I know/they need a large house
questions.answer: I know they need a large house.

grammar.title: II. Rewrite the sentences, using a noun clause according to the example. 仿照例句用名词性从句改写下列句子。
grammar.instruction:
Rewrite the sentences, using a noun clause according to the example. 仿照例句用名词性从句改写下列句子。

Example (item 1):
"I feel cold. I'm afraid that I've got a temperature." (she/say)
She says she feels cold, and she's afraid she's got a temperature.
grammar.translation: Rewrite each pair of direct-speech sentences using a noun clause (indirect speech), following the printed example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf
grammar.context: 10 items. Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 101 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 532).

questions.prompt: "I feel cold. I'm afraid that I've got a temperature." (she/say)
questions.answer: She says she feels cold, and she's afraid she's got a temperature.

questions.prompt: "I've hurt my leg. I think that I shall have an X-ray tomorrow." (he/say)
questions.answer: He says he's hurt his leg, and (he) will have an X-ray tomorrow.

questions.prompt: "We've got mumps. We're afraid that we can't go to school next week." (they/say)
questions.answer: They say they've got mumps, and they're afraid they can't go to school next week.

questions.prompt: "I've got a headache. I believe that I've got flu." (she/say)
questions.answer: She says she's got a headache, and she believes she's got flu.

questions.prompt: "I've just had a car crash. I know that I must drive carefully." (he/say)
questions.answer: He says he's just had a car crash, and he knows he must drive carefully.

questions.prompt: "You'd better go back to the station now. I'm sure that the train will leave soon." (he/say)
questions.answer: He says I'd/we'd better go back to the station now, and he's sure the train will leave soon.

questions.prompt: "I can't read my boss's letter. I'm sorry that I haven't typed it yet." (she/say)
questions.answer: She says she can't read her boss's letter, and she's sorry she hasn't typed it yet.

questions.prompt: "We've already worked for two hours. We think that we need some coffee." (they/say)
questions.answer: They say they've already worked for two hours, and they think they need some coffee.

questions.prompt: "I'm late for the meeting. I'm sorry that my watch is five minutes slow." (he/say)
questions.answer: He says he's late for the meeting, and he's sorry his watch is five minutes slow.

questions.prompt: "I've never been to Paris. But I hope that I'll go there next year." (she/say)
questions.answer: She says she's never been to Paris, but she hopes she'll go there next year.
